videos.title: AI-Generated Code Is Already Competing With Human Code — Daksh Gupta, Greptile
videos.summary: Analyzing over a million enterprise pull requests reveals a shocking reality: fully autonomous AI coding agents now match human software engineers in merge quality, revert rates, and critical bug frequency. Yet, while agents write code just as well as people, they introduce wildly different failure patterns—such as a 50% higher propensity for SQL injections. Watch this talk to see the hard empirical data proving AI coding is already taking over production codebases and learn how engineering teams must adapt their review workflows.
